strategy: One generation per requested sprite or icon. Twenty tower variants use the generated base tower as their image reference.
commonStyle: Final transparent fantasy cartoon Tower Defense asset. Clean bold dark outlines, warm brown timber, cream and gold accents, upper-left lighting. No text, letters, numbers, UI, ground or external shadow. Readable at gameplay size.
baseTower: ArcherTower_0_0: one visible hooded green-cloaked archer holding a wooden bow on a compact wooden watchtower. Orthographic three-quarter slightly top-down view, front and right visible. Centered on a square canvas, stable footprint and bottom anchor, room for future twin archers.
towerVariantTemplate: Create ArcherTower_{Path1}_{Path2} by editing the base reference. Preserve the tower family, camera, perspective, approximate footprint, scale, bottom anchor, lighting and art style. Both path feature sets must visibly coexist. Exactly one archer below Path1 level 3; exactly two visible archers at Path1 levels 3 and 4. Path2 levels 3 and 4 require a horizontal crossbow rather than a vertical bow. Actual transparent background.
path1VisualFeatures: Original single archer and simple wooden bow.
Sharper orange-tipped steel arrows and reinforced leather quiver.
Sharper arrows, gold recurved quick-draw bow, orderly double quiver and wrist bracer.
Exactly two distinct hooded archers side by side, each holding a gold recurved bow; reinforced twin firing platform and double quivers.
Exactly two distinct archers with ornate gold rapid-fire bows, gold wrist bracers, abundant arrow racks and premium reinforced railings.
path2VisualFeatures: Scout telescope on the railing and cyan scouting pennant.
Scout telescope, cyan pennant, blue-fletched arrows and blue-gold aerodynamic arrow rack.
One archer wielding a horizontal dark wooden crossbow with stock and visible horizontal arms; scout telescope, cyan pennant, blue bolts and reinforced aiming rest.
One archer wielding a heavy horizontal crossbow, orange steel bolt tip, reinforced steel/gold arms, premium aiming rest, scout telescope and cyan pennant.
iconTemplate: One final transparent square fantasy cartoon upgrade icon, centered complete subject, consistent bold dark brown outlines, polished clean cartoon art. Warm wood, cream/gold and subtle functional accent colors. Readable at 48px. No text, numbers, card background, ground or shadow.

upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P1_L1_Damage: Sharp polished arrowhead with orange impact spark.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P1_L2_AttackSpeed: Wooden recurved bow firing three small arrows with short gold motion lines.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P1_L3_TwinArchers: Exactly two green hooded archer heads and two wooden bows.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P1_L4_ArrowStorm: Fan of six arrows with strong golden speed trails.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P2_L1_Range: Wooden watchtower in a cyan circular range zone with green outward arrows.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P2_L2_ProjectileSpeed: One arrow with a long blue and gold trail; no bow.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P2_L3_PiercingCrossbow: Dark brown/gold crossbow with bolt passing through two target discs.
upgradeIconConcepts.ArcherUpgrade_P2_L4_HeavyBolts: Thick orange steel-tipped bolt piercing three target discs with impact spark.

projectileConcepts.Archer_Arrow: One slim horizontal brown wooden arrow pointing right, cream feather fletching left and sharp silver point right. No bow, trail or targets.
projectileConcepts.Archer_CrossbowBolt: One short thick horizontal dark wooden bolt pointing right, gold collar, blue fletching left and orange steel point right. No crossbow, trail or targets.

import: Alpha-preserving downsampling and canvas normalization only. Tower canvases 512x512 with bottom anchor y490; icons 512x512 centered; projectiles 512x128 centered. See manifest.json for each final image hash and status.
